title: 第88章 你唐敬太肮脏，连祭天都不配！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚大结局全文免费阅读
content_zh: 唐敬目光犀利如刀，想要将唐逸给看穿。　　他难以再保持淡定，因为唐逸所说的数目，和他从国库中借出来的账目丝毫不差，这让他心头顿时一阵发毛，一时之间分不清楚，唐逸是在诈他，还是真有证据。　　难道，唐逸找到顾城的账簿了？　　这不可能！　　他们有人监督顾城，根本就没有发现顾城记有账簿，更别说锦衣卫二处已经将顾家里里外外翻个底朝天了！　　那唐逸是怎么知道的？顾城已经死了，难道还能托梦告诉他？！　　“怎么？唐侍郎急了？”　　唐逸戏谑一笑，道：“是不是汗流浃背心头发毛了？是不是在想我怎么知道的？是不是……很想杀我灭口？”　　“其实很简单，我吓唬你的。”　　唐逸手敲了敲桌案，道：“吓唬人而已，我也会。你吓唬我外婆，我吓唬你，很公平。”　　“当然，是有区别的。区别在你是在捏造的，而我只是在阐述一个事实。”　　“所以，唐侍郎还是准备好银子吧，一旦开朝陛下问起来，唐侍郎要是没钱还，陛下可是会生气的。”　　唐家现在是个什么样子，唐逸很清楚。　　那是连几百两都拿不出来了，真要筹六万两还给国库，唐敬只能卖房卖地卖店铺了。　　柳老太太看着唐逸，嘴角微微扬起，心头的郁闷几乎一扫而光。　　谁说他柳家无人的？谁说他柳家没有人出头的。　　这不就有了吗？　　颜霜玉脸色已经苍白下来，紧张得手中的手帕都被撕裂了。　　她很清楚唐敬从国库拿了多少银子，因为他就是靠这些银子，从乡下便开始一步步将唐画给装裱起来的。　　“你，放肆！”　　唐敬被唐逸气得脸色铁青，一巴掌狠狠拍在了桌上。　　他凑上前，脸几乎贴在了唐逸的脸上：“我不欠国库什么钱，你少在这里危言耸听，你真以为……我不敢把你怎么样是吗？”　　“唐侍郎，你这就玩不起了！”唐逸收起绣春刀，淡淡道：“我都已经说了，我是在吓唬你，你怎么就这么不禁吓呢？”　　“哦，还有件事……”　　说到这里唐逸侧眸，目光冰冷盯着颜霜玉：“都说我母亲是病死的，以前我相信，但现在……我心头有很多的疑问。”　　“所以，我母亲的死亡真相，我会重新查的。”　　“我现在是锦衣卫，对有疑惑的案子可以重启调查。”　　听到这话，颜霜玉向后退了两步，脸色煞白。　　唐逸上前一步，逼近她，声音拔高了几分：“唐二夫人，我娘，是你害死的。”　　“不，我没有，你胡说，你是在诬陷！”颜霜玉声音尖锐，大声反驳。　　柳如玉自然是她害死的，但收尾处理得很干净，没有留下一点痕迹。　　唐逸就算查，也不可能查出半点蛛丝马迹……只是看着少年那冷冽的目光，让她莫名的心颤和恐惧。　　那一双眼睛，仿佛能看穿她所隐藏的一切。　　“别那么激动，我就是随口一问，吓唬人的。”　　唐逸轻笑一声，转身扶着柳老太太往外走：“外婆，我们走吧，以后想我和音儿了，叫人过来叫我们一声就行，别登门了，免得让柳家沾染晦气。”　　同时，他冰冷的声音在院中传开。　　“唐侍郎，如今东虞犯边，北狄压境，大战一触即发，随时可能会生灵涂炭，血流成河，而陛下，做了他作为一个君王该做的事。”　　“调兵驰援，筹备物资，调集粮草……”　　“而你们呢？你们作为大乾朝中重臣，你们做了你们应该做的了吗？”　　“没有，都这个时候了，你们不是想着去帮助皇帝解决大炎危机，想着的还是自己手中那点蝇营狗苟！”　　“你们……真的很可耻，只配杀了祭天！”　　“不对，你们这些人，太过于肮脏，连祭天……都不配！”　　他字字珠玑。　　每一个字，都宛如巴掌一般落在唐敬的脸上。　　将唐敬乃至于满朝大臣身上的遮羞布，给彻底撕烂捣毁。　　啪！　　唐逸恼羞成怒，一巴掌拍在桌上怒喝：“逆子，逆子！你放肆……”　　然而，唐逸却看都没看他一眼，带着柳老夫人出了门。　　直到几人的背影消失在大门，颜霜玉才脸色煞白走上前，扶着唐敬：“老爷，唐逸……唐逸到底是怎么知道，你欠国库的具体账目的？”　　“他，难道真的找到了证据了？”　　唐敬看了眼霜玉一眼，一甩衣袖怒道：“看不出来吗？唐逸是在给他外婆和舅妈出气，故意嘲讽我们的。”　　“证据？顾城的案子就没有证据，他是想通过我将消息放出去，让人去锦衣卫毁坏证据。”　　“这逆子，其心可诛！”　　听到这话，颜霜玉这才松了一口气。　　没有证据就好。　　不然，到时候就是欺君之罪，那后果不堪设想。　　而这时的唐家门外，柳老夫人看着身侧的唐逸，笑容慈祥：“你真的是我的孙儿小逸？这伶牙俐齿气势磅礴的样子，可和曾经的乖孩子不一样。”　　唐逸脑袋往老人家手掌上蹭了蹭，道：“我在外婆面前，永远都是乖孩子。”　　听到这话，柳老太太脸上的笑容顿时更浓了，她回头看了一眼唐家，又看向唐逸道：“你大舅和文彦的事，外婆就交给你了。”　　“但无论何时，都以自己的安全为先，如果事不可为就不要为，柳家不会怪你。”　　唐逸点头，道：“大舅也是这样说的……呃，外婆，大舅不是已经写了亲笔信去柳家报平安了吗？你们怎么还来求唐敬？”　　姜氏眉心一跳，连忙低下头。　　柳老夫人和沈氏相视一眼，脸色震惊：“信？什么信？我们没收到信啊！”　　闻言，唐逸眉头不由微微皱了起来，不应该啊，昨日林豹不是已经将信送到柳家了吗？怎么会没收到？　　“算了，可能是我的人寄错了。”　　唐逸拍了拍外婆的手，道：“外婆，大舅的事交给我就行，你们回家等消息就可以了。”　　“这段时间，不用找人求情，也不要相信其他任何人能帮柳家，免得落进人家的圈套里。”　　“好了，我去上班了，外婆再见。”　　唐逸和柳老夫人打了个招呼，转身便向马车跑去。　　看着唐逸的背影，柳老夫人嘴角的笑容一点点收敛。　　“回去查一下，昨日是否有人来送信。”　　“若是有人吃里扒外，杖杀！”
content_en: Tang Jing's eyes were as sharp as a knife and he wanted to see through Tang Yi.It was difficult for him to remain calm anymore, because the amount Tang Yi said was exactly the same as the account he borrowed from the treasury. This made his heart suddenly feel hairy. He couldn't tell for a while whether Tang Yi was defrauding him or if there was real evidence.Could it be that Tang Yi found Gu Cheng's account books?This is impossible!They had someone supervising Gu Cheng, but they didn't even realize that Gu Chengji had any account books, let alone that the Second Jinyiwei Division had turned Gu's home inside out!Then how did Tang Yi know?Gu Cheng is already dead, can he still tell him in a dream?!"What? Mr. Tang is anxious?" Tang Yi smiled jokingly and said, "Are you sweating and getting hairy on your vest? Are you thinking about how I know this? Do you...want to kill me to silence me?" "Actually, it's very simple. I'm scaring you." Tang Yi knocked on the table and said, "It's just to scare people, I can do it too. You scare my grandma,It's fair for me to scare you." "Of course, there is a difference.The difference is that you are fabricating it, and I am just stating a fact." "So, Minister Tang, you should prepare the money.If His Majesty Tang doesn't have the money to pay back, Your Majesty will be angry." Tang Yi knows what the Tang family is like now.That means he can't even get out a few hundred taels. If he really wants to raise 60,000 taels and return it to the treasury, Tang Jing will have no choice but to sell his house, land and shop.Old Mrs. Liu looked at Tang Yi, the corners of her mouth raised slightly, and the depression in her heart was almost wiped away.Who said he has no one in the Liu family?Who says that no one from the Liu family can stand out?Isn’t this already the case?Yan Shuangyu's face turned pale, and she was so nervous that the handkerchief in her hand was torn.She knew very well how much money Tang Jing took from the treasury, because he relied on this money to frame Tang paintings step by step from the countryside."You are so presumptuous!" Tang Jing was so angry that Tang Yi turned livid and slapped the table hard.He came forward, his face almost touching Tang Yi's: "I don't owe the treasury any money, so don't be alarmist here. Do you really think...I don't dare to do anything to you?" "Tang Shilang, you can't afford it anymore!" Tang Yi put away the embroidered spring knife and said calmly: "I have already said that I am scaring you, why can't you help being scared?" "Oh, there is one more thing..."At this point, Tang Yi turned his head and stared at Yan Shuangyu with cold eyes: "They said that my mother died of illness. I used to believe it, but now... I have a lot of questions in my mind." "So, I will re-investigate the truth about my mother's death." "I am now a Jin Yiwei, and I can restart the investigation of cases where there are doubts." Upon hearing this, Yan Shuangyu took two steps back, her face turned pale.Tang Yi took a step forward, approached her, and raised his voice a little higher: "Second Madam Tang, my mother was killed by you." "No, I didn't. You're talking nonsense. You're making a false accusation!" Yan Shuangyu retorted loudly with a sharp voice.Of course she was responsible for Liu Ruyu's death, but the finishing touches were very clean, leaving no trace.Even if Tang Yi checked, it was impossible to find any clues... Just looking at the young man's cold eyes made her heart tremble and fear inexplicably.Those eyes seemed to be able to see through everything she was hiding."Don't be so excited. I just asked casually to scare people." Tang Yi chuckled, turned around and helped Old Mrs. Liu go out: "Grandma, let's go. If you miss me and Yin'er from now on, just ask someone to come and call us. Don't come to the door, so as not to bring bad luck to the Liu family." At the same time, his cold voice spread in the courtyard."Shilang of the Tang Dynasty, now Dongyu invades the border and Beidi presses the border. The war is about to break out. Lives may be wiped out and blood will flow into rivers at any time. However, Your Majesty has done what he should do as a king." "Mobilizing troops to help, preparing supplies, mobilizing food and grass..." "And you? As important ministers in the Great Qian Dynasty, you have done what you should do."No, it's time. You are not thinking about helping the emperor solve the Great Flame crisis, but you are still thinking about the little flies and dogs in your hands!""You... are really shameful. You are only worthy of killing the gods!"Every word fell like a slap on Tang Jing's face.Completely tore up and destroy the fig leaf worn by Tang Jing and even the Manchu ministers.Snap!Tang Yi became angry with shame, slapped his hand on the table and shouted angrily: "You traitor, you traitor! You are so presumptuous..." However, Tang Yi took Mrs. Liu out without even looking at him.It wasn't until the backs of several people disappeared from the door that Yan Shuangyu stepped forward with a pale face and supported Tang Jing: "Master, Tang Yi...how did Tang Yi know the specific accounts you owed the treasury?" "Did he really find the evidence?" Tang Jing glanced at Shuangyu, flicked his sleeves and said angrily: "LookDon't you want to come out?Tang Yi is venting his anger on his grandmother and aunt and deliberately mocking us."Evidence? There is no evidence in Gu Cheng's case. He wants to let people go to Jinyiwei to destroy the evidence."Hearing this, Yan Shuangyu breathed a sigh of relief.It’s fine if there’s no evidence.Otherwise, it will be the crime of deceiving the emperor, and the consequences will be disastrous.At this time, outside the door of the Tang family, Mrs. Liu looked at Tang Yi beside her with a kind smile: "Are you really my grandson Xiaoyi? This sharp-tongued and majestic look is different from the good boy you once were."Tang Yi rubbed his head against the old man's palm and said, "I will always be a good boy in front of my grandma." After hearing this, the smile on Old Mrs. Liu's face suddenly became thicker. She turned back and glanced at the Tang family,Then he looked at Tang Yi and said, "Grandma will leave your uncle and Wen Yan's affairs to you." "But no matter what, always put your own safety first. If something cannot be done, don't do it. The Liu family will not blame you." TangYi nodded and said, "Uncle said the same thing... Well, grandma, didn't uncle already write a handwritten letter to the Liu family to report that he was safe? Why do you still come to beg Tang Jing?" Mrs. Jiang's eyebrows jumped and she quickly lowered her head.Mrs. Liu and Mrs. Shen looked at each other with shock on their faces:
title_en: Chapter 88 You, Tang Jing, are so filthy that you are not even worthy of offering sacrifices to heaven!
